raw_segments.text: Such an act that blurs the grace and blush of modesty, calls virtue hypocrite, takes
off the rose from the fair forehead of an innocent love, and sets a blister there.
Makes marriage vows as false as Dicer's oaths.
O, such a deed as from the body of contraction plucks the very soul, and sweet religion makes
Heaven's face doth glow, yea this solidity and compound mass, with tristful visage as
against the doom, is thought sick at the act.
